Name: Joja Coffee
Author: Nepzp
Description:
Joja corporation's latest product helps you walk faster.
Using 3 joja cola and 1 Triple Shot Espresso to make 1 joja coffee.
 Joja coffee and joja cola can be purchased at the saloon and the joja market now.

Joja公司最新产品让你健步如飞。
用3瓶joja可乐和一杯3倍浓缩咖啡制作一杯joja咖啡，好喝！腰不酸了腿不疼了！
现在可以在星之酒吧和joja超市购买joja咖啡和可乐了。
